overall_assessment: Section splitting is largely correct for UiS: learning outcomes keep all Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse groups, prerequisites are clean, and the 'Vilkår for å gå opp til eksamen' block is separated from assessment. Most pre-pass flags (empty/boilerplate teaching_methods, blob on the MGL3066 reading lists, leak->X) are false alarms. The remaining defects are noise: PDF page furniture and link-resolver URLs inside sections, the UiS workload boilerplate in course_content, and Introduksjon repeating Innhold.

findings.description: FS-PDF running headers and footers survive inside section text: 'Emne X, BOKMÅL, , versjon' (reading_list, assessment) and '<CODE> - <course title>' (learning_outcomes, reading_list), often in the middle of a sentence or list. These are page furniture, not content, and they break lists (e.g. the assessment text in LFYMAS-1 is split by one).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Page headers/footers are never stripped from the text-fallback path; .section_noise in R/extract_sections.R does not cover uis page furniture and does not apply to learning_outcomes or reading_list.
findings.suggested_fix: For uis, strip lines matching '(?m)^\s*Emne [A-ZÆØÅ0-9_]+, (?:BOKMÅL|NYNORSK|ENGELSK).*versjon.*$' and lines equal to '<emnekode> - <title>' (code from course_id) before the sections are cut, or add them to .section_noise for all sections.

findings.description: Library OpenURL resolver strings (hundreds of characters of rft.*= parameters, ctx_tim timestamps, an internal user_ip) are embedded in reading_list entries and make up most of the 28k-46k char reading lists in MGL3066/MGL4066. The blob flag is a false alarm for length (a long reading_list is expected), but the resolver URLs are noise that pollutes otherwise correct bibliographic text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The reading list is copied verbatim from the library system; there is no cleanup of OpenURL link-resolver strings for uis.
findings.suggested_fix: In the uis cleanup, remove tokens matching 'https?://bibsys-ur\.userservices\.exlibrisgroup\.com/\S*(?:\s*\n?\S*rft[._]\S*)*' up to 'View online', or drop any line containing 'rft.' or 'ctx_ver='. Also remove the trailing 'View online' marker.

findings.evidence: Universitetet i Stavanger definerer eit studieår til 40 veker, og arbeidsmengda per 30 studiepoeng er estimert til 412
findings.description: The unmapped 'Arbeidsmengd' (workload) heading and its generic UiS boilerplate (study year = 40 weeks, 412 hours per 30 credits, pages of pensum per credit) is appended to the end of course_content. It is standard admin text, not course content (the course_content flags leak->learning_outcomes/coursework_requirements/reading_list come from content lines and are mostly false alarms).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Arbeidsmengd'/'Arbeidsmengde' has no row in R/section_heading_map.R, so it does not close the previous section and its text is appended to course_content.
findings.suggested_fix: Add exact '.drop' rows for 'arbeidsmengd' and 'arbeidsmengde' in R/section_heading_map.R (or move the hours line to teaching_methods).

findings.evidence: Engelsk er et verdensomspennende litterært språk, og engelsk litteratur blir i dag produsert
findings.description: Introduksjon and Innhold both map to course_content, and in the LENG115/LENG116 plans Innhold repeats the Introduksjon paragraph, so the same sentences appear twice in course_content (also in MGL courses where the intro and a following paragraph overlap). Inflates length and term counts.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Two headings with near-identical text are concatenated into one section without deduplication (R/extract_sections.R, sectionize()/.clean_sections()).
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections(), drop a paragraph in course_content that is a verbatim prefix of, or contained in, another paragraph of the same section.

findings.evidence:
Ingen
Anbefalte forkunnskaper
 Kurset forutsetter solid kompetanse i skriftlig og muntlig engelsk.
findings.description: The placeholder 'Ingen' (no prerequisites) is kept as text, and the sub-heading 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper' leaks into the prerequisites row (in LENG115-2018 as a bare 'Ingen' line before the real text). Minor; recommended knowledge is arguably a prerequisite so the section is correct.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No placeholder filter for 'Ingen' in .clean_sections(); the second heading maps to the same section so only its label remains in the text in the text-fallback path.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip standalone 'Ingen'/'Ingen.' lines when other text is present in the section, and drop the sub-heading label line.
